Method of Attack: Distributed as fake Adobe Flash Player installer
Uses malicious shell scripts to download additional payloads
Launches base64 encoded and AES encrypted scripts
Collects system information and generates session GUID
Downloads second stage payload via custom URL and curl
Unzips password-protected payload and executes it
Escalates privileges using sudo with /usr/libexec/security_authtrampoline technique
Disables Gatekeeper protection mechanism to run unsigned payloads
Downloads and runs adware payloads signed with valid Apple developer IDs
Attack Vector: Fake Adobe Flash Player update pop-ups on hijacked or cloned legitimate websites
DMG, PKG, ISO, or ZIP files, some signed with valid Apple developer IDs
Indicators of Compromise: Executable hashes, domains used by the malware campaign, IP addresses of C&C servers (available on Carbon Black’s GitHub page)
